vertical_slices.title: Target identity
vertical_slices.flow: CPU/SoC + stepping + board + ABI identity → schema validation → supported/unknown classification → evidence record.

vertical_slices.title: Cross-build qualification
vertical_slices.flow: Pinned E2K toolchain → compiler/linker check → reproducible artifact → static inspection → explicit pass/block report.

vertical_slices.title: Physical target qualification
vertical_slices.flow: Exact hardware identity → approved test procedure → captured measurements/logs → independent review → qualified scope.

guardrails: Do not claim an E2K kernel, bare-metal boot path, production runtime or hardware compatibility until exact target source and reproducible evidence exist. Never infer E2K register, ABI, memory or toolchain behavior from x86/Arm. Host tests prove only host logic.
status_note: Architecture contract only; target support requires actual source implementation and reproducible evidence.
